name: Global-Local Depth Normalization
definition: A depth loss normalization technique that processes depth patches at both global and local scales to prevent scale-invariant losses from overlooking minor depth variations, thereby improving detailed geometry reshaping in texture-rich regions.
summary: Global-Local Depth Normalization is a 3D Gaussian Splatting technique that combines global scale preservation with local scale amplification to capture minor depth variations ignored by standard scale-invariant losses.
